title: Fermionic Hamiltonian engineering with local control
summary: Quantum simulators enable the exploration of complex quantum phenomena in condensed-matter systems by reproducing their dynamics on controllable quantum devices. However, experimental constraints often restrict the class of Hamiltonians that can be realized natively. Hamiltonian engineering addresses this limitation by expanding the set of accessible Hamiltonians beyond the fixed system Hamiltonian provided by the hardware.
